scope: Isolated Godot Web HTTPRequest diagnostic using the production OnlineRoomClient; not a production lobby or battle run.
repeatability: The fresh target auto-loaded once before the collector attached and was then reloaded with cache disabled; both complete sequences produced the same four status/transport results. Both created rooms were left successfully.
reproduction: Copy godot/online_room_client.gd into a minimal temporary Godot project.
Export the isolated project to dist/web/_http_probe/index.html with Godot 4.7.2.
Serve the Web export on localhost:8000 and use service endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8787.
Open a fresh Chrome CDP target on localhost:8000, enable Network and Runtime, reload, and collect only Online HTTP diagnostic (redacted) plus fixed probe markers.
limitations: No production Main/menu/lobby path or menu keyboard input was exercised.
No WebRTC signaling, gameplay channel, rollback battle, real result submission, external network, or deployed service was tested.
The page stayed in a background target; no focus emulation or Page.bringToFront was used.
